overloadMerges.note: The single doc syntax line has an optional leading '*' discriminator (list as object-name string vs. hierarchical list reference number), correctly kept as one optional param by the draft parser; added the documented 0/'*' sentinel values for itemRef and the function-result semantics.

params.description: If present, list is an object name (string) representing the list in the form; if omitted, list is a hierarchical list reference number.

params.name: list
params.description: List reference number (if * omitted), or object name of the list-type form object (if * passed).

params.name: itemRef
params.description: Item reference number whose parent is sought.

sentinelValues.meaning: The last item added to the list.
The current item of the list (the last one selected, if several were selected manually); requires the object-name syntax (first '*' passed) if multiple representations of the same list exist.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the item reference number of the parent of the designated item, or 0 if the item doesn't exist, has no selected current item, or has no parent.
